messages:
elaine (AE): FYI Meteor ran our RFI and wants a short deep-dive on POC economics + an ask about deferring license until production. they also flagged quantization impact on accuracy. can we sync?
junaid (SE): happy to. main asks i saw: 1) POC throughput targets (qps + latency), 2) estimated per-token cost for candidate models incl. int8/4 quant profiles, 3) contract language for deferral/credit.
marco (SalesEng): i'll own the POC ops plan. need to know whether they want Dedicated or Private. leaning private due to data residency.
elainE (AE): small typo :) it's elaine. they prefer Private w/ customer-managed VPC. asked about HSM/KMS and whether we can do a delayed billing clause for 90 days.\ljunaid (SE): for quantization: we have benchmarks for 8-bit and 4-bit on similar 7B/13B models — tradeoff matrix i can paste. accuracy drop is usually ~1-3% on Rouge/F1 for classification tasks, but depends on prompt sets. recommend we run 3-shot evals during POC.
marco (SalesEng): can you paste the matrix here so i can include in the RFI response doc? customer wants a table they can include in their procurement packet.
junaid (SE): putting quick table below (abbrev):
```
Model     | FP16 perf | int8 perf | int4 perf | est token cost delta | acc delta (task-dependent)
7B       | 1x        | 0.6x     | 0.4x     | -25% / -50%         | -1% / -3%
13B      | 1x        | 0.65x    | 0.45x    | -22% / -48%         | -1.5% / -4%
```
Use these as starting estimates. i can run their sample dataset for accurate numbers.
lisa (Product): for deferral: legal prefers a credit-based approach: customer pays 20% up-front as commitment, remaining billed upon go-live or 90 days whichever earlier. ops implications: we'll need billing flagging in Console and a PO number field.
elainE (AE): they asked if we can waive the up-front if they sign a 12-month Dedicated commit. any precedent? :thinking_face:
marco (SalesEng): we've done 3 enterprise deals with delayed up-front for Dedicated. sales/legal did 30-60 day deferrals, 12-month commit required. i'll flag as negotiable but needs revenue ops signoff.
ops-bot: Reminder: create a POC ticket in Jira and attach workload configs. Template: https://redwood-internal/ops/poc-template
elainE (AE): i'll open the ticket after this thread.
junaid (SE): for the RFI capability matrix, include these bullet points: - private deployment (VPC + optional on-prem) - KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, HSM via PKCS#11) - model variants and quant profiles (FP16, int8, int4) - predictable Dedicated throughput with SLA - batching and cache controls to tune cost/latency.
marco (SalesEng): customer also asked about rollback/fallback if quantized model fails quality gates. recommended language?
lisa (Product): default fallback policy: route to FP16 variant in another pool with automated canary check. include SLO: 95th-latency + quality regression alerting to block rollouts. we have a standard snippet i can paste into the RFI.
junaid (SE): action items: 1) I'll run the sample eval on Meteor dataset (ETA 48h). 2) Marco to prepare a POC ops plan + deployment diagram. 3) Elaine to open Jira + collect commercial ask (deferral %). 4) Lisa to provide legal snippet for deferral and fallback.
elainE (AE): thanks all. cc @marco i'll ping procurement directly after jira. attaching the customer's RFI doc: https://drive.company/misc/meteor_rfi_v1.pdf
marco (SalesEng): ack. will draft the capability matrix and send a single PDF we can attach to their procurement packet. aim to have draft by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Jira ticket created: REDW-4821 (POC: Meteor - quant/cost deep-dive).
marco (SalesEng): linking ticket to thread and adding the draft once ready.
elainE (AE): great, closing loop here. if any blocker on legal, call me.
